facts.fact: 醒来懵圈：以为在酒店其实在Logan家
facts.anchor: I wasn’t at the Huxley Grand; I was at Logan’s place.

facts.fact: Coach向GM报备后特批他离队住宿；Berkeley取消酒店，航班次日10点
facts.anchor: the team will give Carson permission to stay off-site if he chooses.

facts.fact: 他反感报备行踪——离家起就没有宵禁
facts.anchor: I hadn’t had a curfew since before I’d left home, and I chafed against the idea.

facts.fact: 沙发上的她睡熟：他只敢盖好毯子、欲抚脸又收手
facts.anchor: I gently rearranged her blanket so it was covering her once more.

facts.fact: 睡错房：挑了“地上东西少的一间”，却是她卧室
facts.anchor: I picked the one that seemed to have less stuff on the floor

facts.fact: 晨间名场面：她跨坐上来确认“你是真的，这不是梦”
误会解开：她地板上是Kylie寄来签名的募捐品
facts.anchor: I forgot that Kylie sent me a bunch of stuff to sign for a fundraiser.

facts.fact: 他自省：完全误判局面，不是第一次——但愿这次没那么灾难
facts.anchor: It was the fact that I’d completely misread the situation, and it wasn’t the first time.

facts.fact: 他的圣诞新传统：球票送给需要的家庭、平安夜慈善
facts.anchor: Instead, I had the front office give away my tickets to fans in need

facts.fact: 父亲控诉：满口爱只在乎控制，他庆幸脱离
facts.anchor: He spoke of love, but all he cared about was control.

facts.fact: Hawks年度家庭日=他最恨的活动（提醒失去的一切）
facts.anchor: the Hawks’ annual family day before the start of the new season was by far my least-favorite event of the year.

facts.fact: 结尾互认安全感；他盼哪天敢把真相说出口
facts.anchor: “I feel safe with you too,” I admitted
